Certainly entertaining enough, even if the plot is weak and to a certain extent, nonsensical. But, that was Hollywood. Glenda Farrell really carries the show as the fast-talking sharp-witted newspaper reporter. Lyle Talbot makes a nice foil for Farrell's craziness. Ralph Sanford plays the obligatory dumb cop, whose somewhat comic presence could have been done without, leaving a tighter film all around. All the other actors are okay.
